_comment: Bulk narration lane. Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0, 82M params, 54 fixed voices, no cloning. Use for anything where per-word diffusion cost is absurd: product-catalogue reads, IVR prompts, long explainer beds, draft scratch tracks before a VibeVoice or Qwen final.
_save_node: SaveAudioMP3 is marked DEPRECATED in current ComfyUI in favour of SaveAudioAdvanced, but it is the right choice on a pinned base: worker-comfyui 5.10.0 fixes a ComfyUI version, and the older node is certainly present there while SaveAudioAdvanced may not be. Revisit on the next base-image bump - if a graph ever 400s on this node, swap to SaveAudio (FLAC, never deprecated) rather than guessing at the newer name. quality options are exactly: V0, 128k, 320k.
_two_nodes: Kokoro is TWO nodes, not one. KokoroSpeaker turns a voice name into a KOKORO_SPEAKER object; KokoroGenerator consumes that plus the text. An earlier draft of this file invented a single 'KokoroSpeech' node and would have failed at request time on a billing GPU - the build-time workflow validation added alongside this fix is what caught it, and is why every class_type here is now asserted against the image at build.
_french_warning: ENGLISH ONLY in practice. Of Kokoro's 54 voices exactly ONE is French (ff_siwis), graded B- on under 11 hours of training data. That is hobby quality and must not ship to a francophone client. Verified from the node source: 11 af / 9 am / 4 bf / 4 bm and a single ff. For French bulk narration use ../../voice-qwen even though it costs more per word.
_lang_values: lang takes DISPLAY names, not codes: English, English (British), French, Japanese, Hindi, Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian. Not 'en-us'.
